# Test fixtures

Images used by `crates/qrtool-decode/tests/fixtures.rs` and for manual testing
(open `demo-screen.png` full screen and press the scan shortcut).

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `url.png` | `https://github.com/Lrniey666/qrcode-tool` |
| `wifi.png` | Wi-Fi `Cafe Guest` / WPA |
| `vcard.png` | vCard contact |
| `disguised-link.png` | `https://paypal.com@evil.example/login` (must be flagged as dangerous) |
| `inverted.png` | light-on-dark QR code |
| `small.png` | QR code with 2 px modules |
| `demo-screen.png` | 1600×1000 page with three codes (link, Wi-Fi, short http link) |

All codes contain example data only.
